title: Associate Manager - Projects
jobDescription:
Role Name:

Associate Manager Projects – Customer Happiness

Grade Applicable:

G2B, G2C

Reporting To:

Manager, Senior Manager

Experience:

5-7 years

Position Description:

As a Team Manager – Customer Happiness, you will lead and manage customer service operations, ensuring smooth workflow, compliance, and high-quality service delivery. The role involves team leadership, performance monitoring, process improvement, and strategic support to achieve business objectives.

·Role Objective

The Assistant Manager – Projects will be responsible for supporting and driving key Customer Happiness initiatives related to automation, AI adoption, process improvement, service efficiency, customer experience, and operational governance. The role will involve project tracking, stakeholder coordination, MIS reporting, performance monitoring, and ensuring timely execution of agreed action items.

·Key Responsibilities

oProject Management & Governance

§Track ongoing and upcoming projects across Customer Happiness.

§Maintain project plans, action trackers, timelines, owners, and status updates.

§Coordinate periodic project reviews with internal and cross-functional stakeholders.

§Highlight delays, risks, dependencies, and support timely closure.

oAutomation & Process Improvement

§Support initiatives related to AI, RPA, self-service, workflow automation, and digital adoption.

§Track adoption, utilization, and performance impact of automation projects.

§Identify process gaps and work with teams to improve efficiency and customer experience.

oMIS, Reporting & Dashboarding

§Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and leadership-level project updates.

§Track project KPIs such as adoption rate, AHT/APT reduction, repeat reduction, reopen reduction, productivity improvement, and cost impact.

§Coordinate with Analytics/MIS teams for data availability, dashboard fixes, and reporting accuracy.

oStakeholder Management

§Work closely with Operations, Quality, Tech, Analytics, Product, Training, and Business teams.

§Follow up on pending action items and ensure timely execution.

§Prepare structured updates for senior leadership reviews.

oRCA & Performance Analysis

§Analyze project performance, process gaps, and customer journey issues.

§Support RCA for misses, delays, low adoption, quality gaps, repeat contacts, reopen cases, and customer escalations.

§Recommend actionable improvements based on data trends.

oDocumentation & SOP Management

§Maintain project documentation, SOPs, process notes, and change logs.

§Ensure project-related updates are documented and communicated to relevant teams.

§Support rollout of new processes and adoption plans.

oRequired Skills

§Strong project management and coordination skills.

§Good understanding of customer service operations and process improvement.

§Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

§Hands-on experience with MIS, dashboards, Excel, Power Point, and reporting.

§Ability to work with cross-functional teams.

§Strong written and verbal communication skills.

§Good follow-up discipline and ownership mindset.

·Preferred Experience

o4 to 6 years of experience in customer service operations, projects, process excellence, quality, analytics, or transformation roles.

oExperience in insurance, fintech, BPO, contact center, or service operations will be preferred.

oExposure to automation, AI, digital self-service, workflow tools, or process improvement initiatives will be an added advantage.

·Key Success Metrics

oTimely completion of project milestones.

oAccuracy and timeliness of project reporting.

oImprovement in adoption of automation or digital initiatives.

oReduction in operational inefficiencies such as repeat contacts, reopens, AHT/APT, or manual effort.

oClosure of action items within agreed timelines.

Quality of stakeholder coordination and leadership updates.

What You Bring to Digit:

You bring leadership, strategic thinking, and a customer-first mindset. You ensure that Digit’s customer service operations run efficiently, meet compliance standards, and deliver exceptional experiences.

title: Financial Analyst - Financial Reporting
jobDescription:
About the Team

The Reporting team is responsible for financial analysis, reporting, and regulatory compliance across the organisation. The key activities of the team include:

  • Performance analysis: Review and analyse segment-wise Profit & Loss, including premiums, investments, claims, commissions, and expenses.

  • Financial reporting: Prepare and analyse financial statements under IGAAP and IND AS, and support transition to new standards such as IND AS 117.

  • Planning and forecasting: Develop Profit & Loss projections based on past trends, market inputs, and discussions with stakeholders.

  • Regulatory reporting: Prepare and submit reports to IRDAI and SEBI in a timely and accurate manner.

  • Monitoring key metrics: Track solvency, loss ratio, combined ratio, and other key indicators, and highlight areas of improvement.

  • Investor communication: Support preparation of investor presentations and quarterly updates with clear and relevant information.

  • Process improvement: Drive automation and improve reporting processes for better efficiency and accuracy.

About the Role

  • Analyse the monthly performance of the company’s investment book, including fixed income and equity portfolios, and track key movements such as yield and unrealised gains.

  • Review investment entries to ensure they are recorded accurately in line with applicable accounting standards (including IND AS 109).

  • Manage reporting related to mutual funds and share timely and accurate information with internal teams.

  • Prepare and review Investment related Notes to Accounts (NTA) and related disclosures for financial reporting.

  • Review investment returns, identify key trends and changes, and highlight important observations.

  • Support quarterly and annual audit closures, including responding to audit queries and providing data and reports as required.

  • Manage reporting requirements as required by regulatory bodies like IRDA/SEBI.

· Support ad hoc analysis, reporting, and projects as required by management from time to time.

Key Requirements:

· EDUCATION: Chartered Accountant

· Experience: Fresher

· Skills in: Understanding of Indian Accounting Standards. Sound understanding of IND AS 109

· Tech Mastery: Proficiency in advanced excel, ability to use AI

· Bonus Power-Up:Good understanding of financial markets and how they function, including key drivers of investment performance.

Why This Role

  • Exposure to financial reporting, investments, and regulatory requirements.

  • Opportunity to work closely with senior management and multiple teams.

  • Involvement in process improvement and automation initiatives.

Location: Bangalore

· MIS dashboards, portfolio analytics and action-oriented review notes

· Own visible, measurable outcomes: faster TAT, better conversion, cleaner governance, stronger product adoption and improved portfolio quality.

title: Social Content Creator - Brand Marketing
jobDescription:
Social Content Creator — Job Description

Company: Digit Insurance
Experience Required: 2–3 years
Function: Marketing / Brand & Social Media

About the Role

At Digit, we believe in making the complicated feel simple, and the ordinary feel a little delightful. We're looking for a Social Content Creator who can do exactly that with social media. Someone who has ideas, can pick up a camera, shoot it, edit it, and get it out into the world, on time and on brand.

You're the one who makes it happen, start to finish.

Key Responsibilities

· Plan and execute the social media content calendar across platforms (Instagram, You Tube, Linked In, etc.)

· Conceptualize, shoot, and edit video and photo content, from quick reels to polished campaign pieces, with your own hands

· Write captions and copy that sound like a person, not a brand deck

· Keep a pulse on trends and platform shifts, and know which ones are actually worth chasing

· Track what's working and quietly kill what isn't

· Ensure everything you make sounds and looks like Digit, especially given the compliance realities of insurance

Requirements

· 2–3 years of experience in social media content creation, with a brand, D2C company, or agency

· Real, hands-on shooting and editing skills (mobile/DSLR, Premiere Pro/Cap Cut or similar)

· A working understanding of platforms, formats, and what actually drives engagement

· An eye for storytelling and pacing that makes people stop scrolling

· Strong written communication

The Must-Have Trick

Good magic rarely happens solo. You'll need to work closely with brand, design, product, and compliance teams, take feedback well, and turn it around fast, all without losing the plot on deadlines. If you can make collaboration look effortless while still owning your craft, that's exactly the kind of practical magician we want.

Good to Have

· Experience creating content in a regulated industry (BFSI, insurance, fintech)

· Comfort with Canva/Photoshop for quick creative assets

· A genuine feel for internet culture and what Gen Z/millennial audiences actually engage with

jobDescription:
ROLE: Strategy & Analytics Consultant

Who are we looking for?

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Strategy & Analytics Consultant to join our Business Planning and Strategy team. We need someone with curiosity and attitude to learn more about the business and solve problems. Ideal candidate is with 1-3 years of experience post MBA

Location: Bangalore

Roles and RESPONSIBILITIES:

The candidate is expected to have a generalist role encompassing data analysis with curiosity for developing strong business understanding. The candidate is eventually expected to develop into full stack consultant who can support in building macro view of the company/industry and micro view of different channels/products for delivering data driven business insights to management as well as contributing to overall monthly & quarterly topline activities


A. Data analysis, Business monitoring activities & projects across Monthly /quarterly/Annual:

1. Monthly performance across various channels and geographies.

2. Monthly target setting and business forecasting for the company at channel/location/product level

3. Industry and competition analysis, market size estimation and market share tracking.

4. Annual operating plan activity both top down and bottom up


B. Work & Coordinate with cross functional business teams

1. Collaborate with sales & Channel teams for business monitoring related queries.

2. Work closely with Sales, Renewal, underwriting, Channel teams to close queries on critical business operations


C. Provide in depth Insights to Management and business projections

1. Analyze data to generate actionable insights using Excel, Power BI.

2. Prepare presentations or documents as required by management

3. Incorporating business Insights into planning monthly, quarterly targets & projections


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and handle large volume of data to generate insights.

  • Skills needed – MS Excel, MS Power Point, MS Word, Power BI , strong communication and inter-personal skills

  • Strong ownership of tasks with obsession to quality and Attention to details

Position Description: A Sales Manager (Agency and Broking) is primarily responsible to supervise the business delivery under agency and brokers for a branch.


Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive and achieve monthly topline targets through agency and broking vertical
  • Ensure diversification of portfolio into motor, non-motor, health products for the location they are managing
  • Achieving business goals and revenue targets.
  • Drive recruitment of agents / brokers through team members as per targets set
  • Coordinate with team to ensure month on month activation of agents / brokers as per targets set
  • Manage individual targets for agent and broker recruitment, activation and premium if any
  • Responsible for achieving overall GWP (Gross Written Premium)
  • Responsible for sustainable profitability
  • Responsible to maintain COR at budgeted levels
  • Combined Ratio- Minimizing Loss & Cost of Acquisition
  • Ensuring IRDAI compliance regarding licensing
  • Handling a team of relationships managers.
  • Train team on products, process and USPs of Company
  • Identify the area of improvement & enhancing business opportunity
  • Responsible for explorations & identification of new business avenues by way of business leads & networking.
  • Resolve the discrepancies raised by the Underwriter and issue policies at branch level.
  • Analysing and resolving the rejections of policy related issues

Professional Experience: 7+ years; experience in GI with agencies / brokers

Skills / behavioural traits required:
  • Basic Excel
  • Team Leader
  • Agility, Initiative
  • Interpersonal Skills
  • Communicational Skills
  • Negotiation Skills
  • Proactiveness
  • Assertiveness
  • Excellent leadership and decision-making skills
  • Ability to multitask and work efficiently under pressure

Company: Go Digit General Insurance

Location: Mumbai & Delhi

WHAT THIS ROLE IS:

Field-facing role at the intersection of business development, product adoption, and partner support. You will own the rollout and adoption of Digit’s technology stack across insurance distribution partners in your territory — not from a desk, but by being present with partners and their teams. You will be the face of Digit’s partner technology initiative on the ground.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

· Drive adoption of Digit’s partner-facing technology tools across assigned partners — onboard new partners, train agent teams, and push active usage across modules (renewals, fresh business, winback, automated calling).

· Own end-to-end technology setup for partners: configure accounts, upload data, run handholding sessions, and ensure tools are live and being used before you move to the next partner.

· Be the first point of contact for partner-side issues and bugs — log, triage, and follow through to resolution with the tech team. Partners should never be chasing.

· Accompany sales on partner visits and independently run technology review meetings — come prepared with data on what the partner is and isn’t using.

· Track partner activity and flag disengaging partners before they go dormant. Proactively intervene.

· Feed ground-level product feedback into the central team — what’s breaking, what’s confusing, what partners are asking for.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

· 2–4 years in a partner-facing, field sales, or technology adoption role — insurance, fintech, or Saa S distribution is a plus.

· Comfortable picking up and troubleshooting software tools quickly — not a developer, but you shouldn’t need hand-holding.

· Strong with people: can train a room of telecallers, hold a review with a partner’s leadership, and escalate issues to tech — all in the same day.

· Understand Data metrics

Department: Motor Claims – Survey & Assessment


Position Overview:

As an Internal Surveyor, you will be responsible for surveying and assessing claim applications, determining the genuineness of claims, and preparing detailed reports on losses. Your role ensures that damaged vehicles are surveyed efficiently, customer escalations are resolved, and outstanding claims are periodically reviewed for speedy disposal.


Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

Survey & Assessment of Claims:

  • Conduct thorough assessments of claim applications to determine losses.

  • Prepare reports verifying the genuineness of claims while ensuring damaged vehicles are properly surveyed.

Claims Processing & Settlement:

  • Process and settle claims in accordance with company policies and guidelines.

  • Follow up on outstanding claims to ensure timely closure.

Customer & Channel Escalation Handling:

  • Address escalations from customers and business channels effectively, ensuring swift resolutions.

Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination:

  • Work closely with external vendors within specified turnaround times.

  • Collaborate with law enforcement officials, eyewitnesses, and lawyers when required.

  • Maintain strong relationships with workshops and dealers to ensure seamless claim execution.

Turnaround Time (TAT) & Compliance:

  • Ensure adherence to TAT across all assessment and claim processes as per defined SOPs.


Requirements:

  • Workshop background or prior experience in general insurance is preferable.

  • Diploma, BE, or BTech in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering.


Technical & Behavioral Skills:

Team Collaboration:

  • Ability to work effectively within a team and contribute to collective success.

Negotiation & Decision-Making:

  • Strong negotiation skills for handling claims and stakeholder discussions.

Communication & Analytical Thinking:

  • Clear and confident communication skills to interact with various parties involved in claim assessments.


Why This Role Matters:

Ensuring fair and accurate claims assessment is crucial in maintaining transparency and trust in insurance operations. Your expertise in surveys and risk analysis will contribute to efficient claim settlements and overall business integrity.
